Definition: Uzziel, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Uzziel = "my strength is God"; 1) the 4th son of Kohath and grandson of Levi, uncle of Moses and Aaron; 2) a Simeonite captain, son of Ishi, in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah; 3) descendant of Bela, head of a family in the tribe of Benjamin; 4) a musician of the sons of Heman in the time of David; 5) a Levite of the sons of Jeduthun in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah; 6) son of Harhaiah, probably a priest and a goldsmith, who took part in repairing the wall under Nehemiah
